python3 << 'EOF'
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from datetime import datetime

# Use the current system date (August 14, 2026)
today = datetime.now().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Current date: {today}")

width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas("cover_page.pdf", pagesize=letter)

# Title centered on page
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 32)
title = "Annual Financial Report"
title_width = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 32)
c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height / 2 + 20, title)

# Date below title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 20)
date_text = today
date_width = c.stringWidth(date_text, "Helvetica", 20)
c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_text)

# Add a decorative line between title and date
c.setLineWidth(2)
c.line((width - 200) / 2, height / 2 - 5, (width + 200) / 2, height / 2 - 5)

c.save()
print("Cover page created: cover_page.pdf")
EOF
